title: EVN Cup mission · Level 3: All six, shuffled
brief: As level 2, with the cargo cubes' colours shuffled on the shelf and the rover and the beacon placed at random in their zones, from the seed; the mat's shade and the room's light vary; no attachment. Pass: mean 114 / 190 (60). Par: 140 / 190 (73.7). M6 needs your program to end without an error at least 1 s before the 120 s. The mat's layout is a proposal (owner item EC-1).
